name: JumpCloud
desc: Manage JumpCloud users, devices, groups and applications.

actions.name: create_object
actions.description: Create a user, group or application. Devices join JumpCloud by installing the agent, so they cannot be created here.

actions.name: update_object
actions.description: Change fields on a user, device, group or application. Fields you leave empty keep their current value.

actions.name: delete_object
actions.description: Permanently delete a user, device, group or application.

actions.name: get_object
actions.description: Get a user, device, group or application, with its main fields and the full JumpCloud record.

actions.name: list_objects
actions.description: List users, devices, groups or applications, one page at a time or all pages at once.

actions.name: list_objects_by_id
actions.description: Get many users, devices, groups or applications at once from a list of IDs.

actions.name: search_objects
actions.description: Find users, devices, groups or applications by text or by a field value.

actions.name: create_association
actions.description: Link two JumpCloud objects, such as adding a user to a group or giving a user group access to an application or device.

actions.name: delete_association
actions.description: Unlink two JumpCloud objects, such as removing a user from a group or revoking a user group's access to an application or device.

actions.name: find_user_by_employee_id
actions.description: Find the JumpCloud user with an exact employee ID, for example one sent by your HR system.

actions.name: lock_user
actions.description: Lock a user so they cannot sign in to JumpCloud, their devices or connected applications until unlocked.

actions.name: unlock_user
actions.description: Unlock a user who was locked by an admin or by too many failed sign-in attempts.

actions.name: reset_user_mfa
actions.description: Clear the multi-factor authentication enrollment of a user so they set it up again, for example after losing their phone.

actions.name: update_user_on_system
actions.description: Set a user's administrator (sudo) rights on a device, binding the user to the device first if you choose.

actions.name: run_trigger_command
actions.description: Run the JumpCloud commands launched by a trigger name, and optionally wait for their results.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Call any JumpCloud API endpoint with this connection. Use a path such as /systemusers for the v1 API or /v2/usergroups for the v2 API.

triggers.name: new_object
triggers.description: Triggers when a new user, device, group or application appears in JumpCloud.
